destination.suggested_title: Scientific Normalization & Acceptance Semantics for the Bounded Richards Temporal Indicator

why_F_SI_owns_next_step: F-VQ31 qualified production/composition correctness but deliberately did not select a scientific normalization or tolerance.
The remaining question is the scientific/numerical meaning of B_inf relative to an admissible error target, not transaction ownership or retry mechanics.
F-KT must not choose a normalization merely to fit its dimensionless <=1 certificate interface; a scientifically justified semantics must exist first.
F-VQ28 and F-VQ29 negative evidence and F-VQ30's strong state/horizon-dependent conservatism must remain authoritative constraints on any candidate.
required_F_SI26_questions: Can B_inf be normalized using a physically and numerically defensible head/state scale without empirical fitting or hidden state-dependent rescue factors?

What quantity should a dimensionless temporal certificate represent: pressure-head error, storage-equivalent error, constitutive-state error, flux/interface error, or a documented multi-criterion combination?
Can one normalization remain meaningful across wet, dry and stiff states without silently changing physics or allowing large absolute errors in insensitive regimes?
How must application-specific accuracy targets be separated from the universal indicator semantics?
Does the available evidence support an actual acceptance threshold, only a ranking/retry signal, or no scientifically defensible production certificate yet?
What fail-closed behavior is required near constitutive singularities, very small capacities, events, boundary discontinuities or unsupported solver/operator envelopes?
required_evidence_reconciliation: F-VQ28 temporal numeric profile and its negative/limiting evidence.
F-VQ29 failure to obtain a qualified finite-reference error bound and its rejection of q_cap/Nmin/geometric-tail rescue as qualification evidence.
F-SI23 raw embedded derivative-difference observer and its extreme conservatism.
F-SI24 analytic bounded stiffness-aware construction and exact-linear factor 2.
F-VQ30 held-out transfer with B_inf/E1_512 approximately 6.69 to 102.50 and strong state/horizon dependence.
F-SI25 production operator semantics and bounded cost.
F-KT10/F-VQ31 transaction-composition correctness and fail-closed nonpromotion to F-KT09 certificate.
candidate_classes_to_assess_without_pres: fixed absolute head scale defined by an explicit application accuracy contract
local/state-dependent head scale derived from constitutive sensitivity, only if it does not become an empirical rescue factor
storage-equivalent normalization based on M-weighted quantities
interface/coupling-relevant normalization tied to flux/head coupling residual goals
multi-criterion acceptance in which B_inf is one diagnostic rather than the sole certificate
ranking-only or retry-advice use if no defensible absolute certificate can be established
hard_holds: Do not fit a factor to make previous cases pass.
Do not infer a true nonlinear error bound from N512 or finite-refinement agreement.
Do not introduce q_cap, Nmin, geometric-tail multipliers or state/material safety coefficients as empirical rescue.
Do not define scientific accuracy from the shape of the F-KT09 <=1 interface.
Do not change Richards physics, mass accounting, boundary semantics or the qualified F-SI24/F-SI25 indicator formula in this assessment.
Do not release production temporal acceptance/retry policy, F-GC02, groundwater coupling or F-PE from owner analysis alone.
If no normalization survives the scientific gates, close fail-closed rather than manufacturing a tolerance.
